name: Full Moon
text:
At the end of your turn:

You may exhaust this card and return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 4 or more to their reinforcements to place 1 structure from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: New Moon
text:
When you perform a strategic action:

You may exhaust this card to capture 1 neutral cruiser.

name: Waxing Moon
text:
At the start of your turn:

You may exhaust this card and return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 2 or more to their reinforcements to draw 2 action cards, then discard 1 action card.

name: Waning Moon
text:
When you pass:

You may exhaust this card and return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 5 or more to their reinforcements to research 1 technology.

name: Lunar Eclipse
text:
Legacy:

This retired relic is retained only for existing games.

name: Half Moon
text:
ACTION:

Exhaust this card and place 1 or more of your captured neutral units in a non-home system that contains no player's ships.

name: Economic Boon
text: Place this card face up in your play area and place a number of control tokens on it equal to the number of planets in systems adjacent to this system. When this card has no control tokens: Discard it. At the start of your turn: You may remove any number of control tokens from this card to place 1 non-fighter ship with a cost equal to or less than the number of tokens removed in a system containing 1 of your space docks.
notes: Control-token count is initialized when this Boon is explored.

name: Nature's Boon
text: Place this card face up in your play area and place a number of control tokens on it equal to this planet's resource value + 1. When this card has no control tokens: Discard it. When you activate a system: You may remove any number of control tokens from this card to increase the resource value of 1 planet you control by 1 for each token removed until the end of that tactical action.

name: Diplomatic Boon
text: Place this card face up in your play area and place a number of control tokens on it equal to this planet's influence value + 1. When this card has no control tokens: Discard it. At any time: You may remove any number of control tokens from this card to place that many fighters from your reinforcements in systems that contain your ships or infantry from your reinforcements on planets you control.

name: Cosmic Boon
text: Place this card face up in your play area and place a number of control tokens on it equal to the number of adjacent systems that contain no planets + 1. When this card has no control tokens: Discard it. At the end of your tactical action: You may remove 1 control token from this card to explore 1 planet you control in the active system.

name: Ancient Radar
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to explore 1 non-home, non-legendary planet you control once for each planet trait, treating that planet as if it had that trait.
flavorText: *The Kairn didn't know exactly how the radar worked, but he did know that whenever it turned on, it always led him to new treasures.*

name: Horn of the Abyss
text:
During combat, when you destroy 1 or more neutral units: You may place 1 unit of the same type as 1 of those units from your reinforcements in that system.

ACTION: You may exhaust this card to place neutral ships with a combined cost of 4 or less in a system that contains no other player's ships.
flavorText: *The captain of the rebels recognized the Horn immediately. The weight it carried was palpable. Whoever carried it was in charge.*

name: Specialized Augmentations
text: Your flagships and mechs each roll 1 additional die during combat and when using unit abilities. Apply +2 to those units' combat rolls and unit ability rolls.
flavorText: *The ancient designs were flawless. How a species so lost in the search for perfection overlooked such designs is a mystery all on its own.*

name: Quantum Entangler
text: ACTION: Choose 1 other player. Draw 3 relics and give 1 of them to that player. Then, that player chooses 1 of the remaining relics to give to you. Purge the remaining relic and this card.
flavorText: *A sudden jolt in the three relics made it clear: they were somehow interlinked. Breaking that link would prove costly.*

name: Mutagen
text: Place this card face up in your play area. This card may be exchanged as part of a transaction. ACTION: Purge 2 of your Mutagen cards and draw 1 random unused faction reference card. Gain 1 of that faction's unused non-unit upgrade faction technologies, 1 of its unused agents, or its alliance card.

name: Mutagen
text: Place this card face up in your play area. This card may be exchanged as part of a transaction. ACTION: Purge 2 of your Mutagen cards and draw 1 random unused faction reference card. Gain 1 of that faction's unused non-unit upgrade faction technologies, 1 of its unused agents, or its alliance card.

name: Mutagen
text: Place this card face up in your play area. This card may be exchanged as part of a transaction. ACTION: Purge 2 of your Mutagen cards and draw 1 random unused faction reference card. Gain 1 of that faction's unused non-unit upgrade faction technologies, 1 of its unused agents, or its alliance card.

name: Mutagen
text: Place this card face up in your play area. This card may be exchanged as part of a transaction. ACTION: Purge 2 of your Mutagen cards and draw 1 random unused faction reference card. Gain 1 of that faction's unused non-unit upgrade faction technologies, 1 of its unused agents, or its alliance card.

name: Volatile Mutagenics
text: ACTION: Purge this card to reveal 1 random unused non-unit upgrade faction technology, 1 random unused agent, and 1 random unused commander. Choose 2 of those components to gain, readied and unlocked, and return the remaining component.
flavorText: *Test 341738: The new line of stabilized mutagenics proves to be the most potent yet. The High Evolutionary will be most pleased with these results.*

name: Alluring Throne
text: When you draw this card: Place the Illustrion planet token in a non-home system adjacent to a system containing a planet you control. Gain control of Illustrion and ready it. After you move 1 of your flagships out of or through Illustrion's system and into a non-home system: You may move the Illustrion token with it.
flavorText: *In a moment of pure desperation, a last alliance of Kryxos and Ponthous engineers was able to co-opt the technology of the Chaos Engines to counteract their effects. The plans were lost in the fight, but their result remains.*
